brief: The my-3D2dge starter: a title menu of small games, one per genre, each a complete slice to copy and change. Its menus and notices are short, arcade-like, mostly in capitals; keep them short, since they sit on a 320 x 240 screen. The player is unnamed and unseen in the menus; address them with the familiar "you" where a line needs one.
